requirements.text: 5+ years of experience building and operating backend software or platform systems in production.
Strong backend engineering skills, with experience in Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Redis, or comparable technologies.
Experience building APIs, integrations, or data pipelines, with attention to correctness, error handling, and maintainability.
Practical experience with AWS or another cloud platform and containerized workloads using ECS, Kubernetes, or similar tools.
An understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including retries, idempotency, queues, and failure recovery.
Experience using logs, metrics, and tracing to debug production issues and improve system reliability.
The ability to work through ambiguity, make pragmatic technical decisions, and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
Ownership and customer focus: you follow through, care about how your work performs in production, and connect technical decisions to customer needs.
Experience with payments, tax, accounting, or other systems where financial data needs to be accurate and auditable.
Experience integrating with billing platforms or ERPs.
Experience building public APIs, developer tooling, or MCP servers.
A background in infrastructure or platform engineering, including Terraform, CI/CD, or observability tooling.
Experience with event-driven systems or evolving a growing application’s architecture.
